title: delta: access denied with table-scoped vended keys on MinIO
description: With the workarounds of duckdb-IO1 and duckdb-IO2, a Delta table of the catalog fails in the `delta` extension (Delta Kernel) with `ObjectStoreError (8): ... lacked the necessary privileges`, on tables with and without `_delta_log/_last_checkpoint`. The keys are MinIO STS keys whose session policy the catalog scopes to the table's prefix (GetObject on the prefix, ListBucket with an `s3:prefix` condition).

delta-rs 1.6.6 reads the same tables with keys vended the same way (both through `uc://` and with the keys passed in `storage_options`), so the keys allow reading the table; which request Delta Kernel makes outside them is not isolated.

Unexplained: the failing call is in the `delta` extension (Delta Kernel's object store), which DuckDB ships out of tree, so DuckDB's v2.0.0 source does not explain it, and which request falls outside the session policy is not isolated.

provenance.checked_by: homelab catalog session (AlexanderNenninger/homelab#9): DuckDB 2.0.0 in Python, extensions unity_catalog cc59382f52, delta 9dcfb65b99, httpfs 77392a7207, against Unity Catalog OSS 0.7.0 with unitycatalog/unitycatalog#1959 on MinIO

evidence.observed: DeltaKernel ObjectStoreError (8): Error interacting with object store: The operation lacked the necessary privileges to complete for path host_minute/ (the table has a _last_checkpoint)
the same error for path ci/job_commits/_delta_log/_last_checkpoint (the table has no _last_checkpoint)

provenance.notes: delta-rs 1.6.6 (`DeltaTable('uc://homelab.ci.job_commits', ...)` and with the resolver's vended keys) read version 8 of the same table in the same container.

evidence.note: no delta directory: the delta extension is out of tree (duckdb/duckdb-delta)

provenance.notes: Unexplained: the failing request is not in DuckDB's tree, and which S3 request falls outside the session policy is not isolated. Docs not assessed; no upstream test.
